def load_model(checkpoint_dir, base_model_override, device):

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(ckpt), trust_remote_code=True)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    model = StructFuseEncoder(
        model_name=model_name,
        proj_dim=cfg.get("proj_dim", 256),
        use_projection=True,
        use_lora=cfg.get("use_lora", True),
        lora_r=cfg.get("lora_r", 16),
        lora_alpha=cfg.get("lora_r", 16) * 2,
        use_fusion_head=cfg.get("use_fusion_head", False),
    )

    state_dict = torch.load(ckpt / "model.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    model.load_state_dict(state_dict, strict=False)
    model = model.to(device)
    model.eval()

    return model, tokenizer, cfg


def discover_checkpoints(root_dir):
    root = Path(root_dir)
    found = []
    for pattern in ["**/best_by_recall_at_1", "**/best_by_val_loss"]:
        for d in sorted(root.glob(pattern)):
            if (d / "model.pt").exists() and (d / "training_config.json").exists():
                found.append(str(d))
    return found
